name: Vocal Tract MRI Segmentation Dataset
description: Accurate segmentation of the vocal tract from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data is essential for various voice and speech applications. Manual segmentation is time intensive and susceptible to errors. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of deep learning algorithms for automatic vocal tract segmentation from 3D MRI.
reputation: A niche medical-imaging dataset used in voice/speech research for automatic vocal tract segmentation; recognized in the specialized community but not widely adopted outside it.
notes: Relatively small, specialized MRI dataset; manual annotation variability and limited subject diversity can affect generalization. Non-LLM benchmark focused on 3D medical image segmentation.
